name: Membership ending soon
subject: Your membership of [% branch.branchname %] ends soon
about: Sent by the cron script misc/cronjobs/membership_expiry.pl, MembershipExpiryDaysNotice days before the membership ends, to a patron who chose 'Patron expiry' in their messaging preferences (or whose category makes it compulsory). Koha prints it when the patron has no address for the way they chose.
